name: Ashgrove Realty
purpose: A CRM for a real estate office: track contacts (buyers and sellers), property listings, and deals through a sales pipeline, with notes on every contact.

entities.name: Contact
relationships: can be a buyer or seller

entities.name: Property
relationships: can be linked to a deal

workflows.name: Manage contacts
workflows.description: Create, edit, and view buyers and sellers with their details

workflows.name: Log notes on contacts
workflows.description: Add timestamped notes to any contact and see them in chronological order

workflows.name: Add properties
workflows.description: Record property listings with address, price, beds/baths, status

workflows.name: Run the deal pipeline
workflows.description: Create deals, attach a contact (and optionally a property), and move them through stages: New, Contacted, Showing, Offer, Under Contract, Closed

workflows.name: View the pipeline
workflows.description: See all deals grouped by stage and drill into any deal

seed_demo: A handful of contacts (mix of buyers and sellers), a few property listings at different statuses, several deals spread across pipeline stages with different values, and sample notes on contacts so every screen reads real.
